curiosity.text: Match the attached reference images exactly in art style: hand-painted Japanese casual cel animation look, soft painted backgrounds with visible gouache texture, clean thin dark-brown character line art, warm natural light, gentle muted palette.

orders.prompt: A finished cinematic anime film frame, characters and background painted together in one image with consistent light and shadow, shallow depth of field, no text. Close-up over a 1986 university wooden desk in morning window light: an older professor's hand in a brown tweed sleeve placing a single blank sheet of lined paper in front of a curly-haired student whose hands hold a pencil. Faces out of frame.
